cover.house: Hardi Plank siding, board and batten detail in the gable and a new roof dress this East End bungalow, with a new driveway down the side of the lot to the covered garage at the back of the fenced yard.
cover.house2: The Living Room, Dining Area and Kitchen share one open run from the front door over wood-look flooring. New wiring, new plumbing and three-phase power are in the house, and the laundry is inside.

second.title: Front Walk
second.body: A wide concrete walk leads from the street to the covered porch, where steps rise to the Craftsman-style front door.

third.title: Top Floor Balcony
third.body: A glass railing balcony runs along the front of the Primary suite, with a view across the treetops past the redwood-clad wall and glass doors opening onto it from the bedroom.

left.title: Living Opens Toward Dining and Kitchen

photos.title: Living Room
photos.body: A tall double-pane window faces the street and a long clerestory window runs high on the wall, bringing in daylight and keeping the room private. Wood-look flooring runs underfoot, and a wide cased opening joins the room to the Dining Area and the open Kitchen with no door or step in between.

photos.title: Kitchen
photos.body: An L-shaped layout with a peninsula, navy lower cabinets, white shaker-style uppers and a stone-look backsplash up to the chimney hood.

photos.title: Dining Area
photos.body: A sputnik-style light fixture hangs over the dining space, which sits beside the breakfast bar, steps from the Living Room and around the corner from the pantry.

photos.title: Breakfast Nook
photos.body: A large double-pane window and wood-look flooring fill the nook behind the Kitchen, which opens to the backyard through a door onto a small deck with steps down.

photos.title: Breakfast Bar
photos.body: The counter is stone-look, with two pendant lights above it and seating along one side; the peninsula gives the cook a prep surface on the other.

right.title: A Vaulted Primary at the Back

photos.title: Primary Bedroom
photos.body: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam rises over the rear Primary Bedroom, which has windows on two outside walls and a double-door closet across the room.

photos.title: Primary Bath
photos.body: A navy vanity holds double sinks in a marble-look top, with an LED backlit mirror above it, a high transom window for daylight and the walk-in shower right beside it.

photos.title: Bedroom 2
photos.body: Windows on two walls face the neighborhood from the front corner of the house, with a closet and the Living Room steps away. It is the larger of the two secondary bedrooms.

photos.title: Bedroom 3
photos.body: The closet and the door sit on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser. The Primary Bedroom is next door, toward the back of the house.

photos.title: Primary Closet
photos.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower, with hanging rods on each side and more shelves above. The built-ins stay.

photos.title: Hall Bath
photos.body: A tub with a full-height marble-look tile surround and a window above it, shared by Bedrooms 2 and 3 and used as the guest bath.

back.title: A Plan, a Covered Garage and a Patio
back.titleNoPlan: A Covered Garage and a Patio

photos.title: Covered Garage and Patio
photos.body: Wood posts and a solid roof cover the garage, which has a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. The open concrete patio beside it measures 8'11" x 25'11", in the fenced yard.

photos.title: Pantry
photos.body: Just off the back corner of the Kitchen, with the Dining Area and the Living Room in view down the length of the house to the front door, past the peninsula and its pendant lights.

notes: From the front door the house runs in one line: Living Room, Dining Area, Kitchen, then the pantry and the Breakfast Nook at the back, where a door opens onto the deck behind the house.
The Primary Bedroom and Bedrooms 2 and 3 come off the hall behind the Dining Area. Out back, the covered garage and the open patio sit side by side in the fenced yard at the back of the lot.
